propositions: AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE journal marker from reclaim_under_pressure is not published as a CloudWatch metric, making pressure-prune activity invisible without host journal access
All sibling autodeploy markers (AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED, AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT, AUTODEPLOY_ERROR) have corresponding metrics, leaving AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE as the only unpublished marker
Incident investigation required inferring reclaim-gate execution indirectly from deploy_deferrals and code branches, when a metric would have directly answered whether the gate ran
The disk_pressure_prunes counter must seed to 0 on first run and publish deltas thereafter, consistent with existing marker-counter behavior
The counter distinguishes root-cause scenarios: gate-never-ran versus gate-ran-but-reclaimed-nothing
